name: MY FORM - Survival and Emergency Basics
_what_this_pack_is: ZERO-SIGNAL, CLOSED-ENUM SURVIVAL CONTENT. Two tiers only, both shipped here: BASIC (a person on a road, in or near a vehicle that cannot move - they are not lost) and BUSH (a person lost on foot or hurt in the backcountry). Every line traces to a named published source, labelled VERIFIED or RESEARCHED per plan/PIVOT/ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md's own convention. Nothing here was generated by a model and nothing here may ever be delivered by one - see _model_boundary below.
_model_boundary: THE MODEL DELIVERS AND DRILLS. IT NEVER AUTHORS. Every string in content/ is pre-rendered pack text, the same shape mvf-pack-vet's triage/ files use. There is no field anywhere in this pack that accepts a model-generated sentence, and no field that accepts open text describing a reader's own situation. If a future reader wires this pack into a chat surface, the model may retrieve and re-state these exact strings; it may never paraphrase, summarise, condense, or extend them, because selecting and re-wording safety content IS authoring it (plan/PLANS/ERP_TRAUMA_PACK_CONTRACT.md section 1, and plan/PIVOT/ERP_MHFA_BRIEF.md section 4, both apply this rule to content well outside their own named domain and this pack treats it as general).

_scope_boundary_read_this_before_adding_.in_this_pack: BASIC (stranded vehicle) and BUSH (lost on foot): stay-put doctrine, being-found signals, water purification, phone facts that are NOT part of a live disagreement, direction/compass limits, two debunked navigation myths, a food-identification refusal, and licence-exempt radio facts. Every item is VERIFIED or RESEARCHED against plan/PIVOT/ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md and carries its source in citations.json.

deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.trauma_or_first_aid_content: NO LICENSABLE SOURCE EXISTS (Red Cross and St John are all-rights-reserved, TCCC's reuse position is unverified and written for a combat medic, plan/REPORTS/ERP_SOURCES_2026-08-07.md section 9) AND NO CLINICAL REVIEWER IS ENGAGED (plan/PLANS/ERP_TRAUMA_PACK_CONTRACT.md section 5: 'THE CLINICAL REVIEWER IS THE BLOCKING GAP AND IT IS NOT A THREAD'S TO FILL'). safety/clinical_clearance.json is the guarded empty slot this ships with instead of a plausible-looking list.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.mental_health_first_aid_protocol: MHFA course materials are closed (all rights reserved, authorised facilitators only) and no accrediting partner has cleared any content yet (plan/PIVOT/ERP_MHFA_BRIEF.md section 10: 'whether a partner exists who would clear content they did not author... is the real feasibility question'). Not authored here at all, not even from the open CC BY journal layer that section identifies, because clearing it is a named partner's job, not a lane's.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.navigation_technique_for_a_person_curren: RULED OUT of emergency content entirely, not deferred. ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 1: 'no recognised SAR body... publishes a taught navigation procedure... addressed to a person who is CURRENTLY LOST.' Basic navigation ships as a separate LEARNING pack per plan/PLANS/FULL_SCOPE.md:1325 and plan/PIVOT/LEARNING_PACKS_SPEC.md, framed for someone at home, not someone in trouble. This pack does not teach a bearing, a shadow-stick, or a star method.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.deviation_guidance_if_a_person_moves_ins: BLOCKING, unanswered. plan/PIVOT/ERP_PARTNER_QUESTIONS.md A0-1/A0-2 ask a search-and-rescue partner whether to give this guidance at all; A0-6 shows three recognised bodies give OPPOSITE terrain-specific answers on the same deviation (follow a drainage downhill / warn against exactly that / avoid going downhill). No partner has answered. This pack states the doctrine plainly and says nothing about what to do instead.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.on_foot_phone_on_or_off: BLOCKING, unanswered. ERP_PARTNER_QUESTIONS.md B1/B2: AdventureSmart and the US NPS say power off; a Government of Canada defence document on an airborne search sensor describes locating an OPERATING handset; ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.3 finds 'a genuine, live disagreement between Canadian authorities' with neither citing the other. This pack ships the facts that are NOT part of that disagreement (any-tower 911 access, no SMS-to-911) and refuses the on/off instruction outright.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.vehicle_headlight_policy: BLOCKING, unresolved. ERP_PARTNER_QUESTIONS.md D1: clear and run, versus clear and leave off until a vehicle is heard, are different instructions and no source resolves it. Omitted.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.ground_to_air_signal_chart: ERP_SURVIVAL_BRIEF.md section 4.2: the international chart sits in a manual sold under copyright, and two Canadian bodies' own five-symbol sets differ in two of five entries. Not reproduced.
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.emergency_alert_and_shelter_routing: RULED, not deferred. plan/PIVOT/ERP_ALERTS_FEASIBILITY.md: the alerting standard carries no destination element at all, and Canada has no public shelter or reception-centre dataset. 'Do not build it.'
deliberately_absent_and_why_each_one.any_claim_that_this_pack_can_navigate_so: Wait times and turn-by-turn routing need the network by design (plan/PLANS/ERP_ZERO_SIGNAL_SPLIT.md section 1); this pack is the zero-signal half only.

_inheritance_note_read_before_assuming_t: plan/PLANS/ERP_TRIAGE_FLOOR_SHAPE.md rules that ERP is meant to become the triage floor every pack inherits, not a pack a user downloads on its own - but that inheritance mechanism, and the client-side crisis-floor port plan/PIVOT/PACKS_SPEC.md section 5b calls a prerequisite, DO NOT EXIST YET. This manifest is authored to the same contract shape mvf-pack-vac and mvf-pack-vet already ship (see README.md), so it is ready to be read by mvf_pack_safety.py's real functions today, and ready to be wired into whichever delivery mechanism HELM chooses later, without a second authoring pass. It does not itself change how src/chat/app.py's erp mode behaves.

languages._note: ENGLISH ONLY, DELIBERATELY, FOR NOW. plan/PLANS/SEAT_BRIEF.md: 'do NOT machine-translate safety content: write the English, keep the keys, and hand the list to HELM for TMK.' fr_ca is not declared as a supported language in this manifest so that mvf_pack_safety.structural_report() does not silently pass a French check this pack cannot actually satisfy. Every _en key that needs a native French pass is listed, unchanged, in content/FRENCH_TODO.md - that is the list to hand to HELM/TMK. This is a real gap under Law 25 and is named as one in README.md, not hidden by a translated-looking manifest.

triage_disclaimer._note: SAME SHAPE AS mvf-pack-vet's, R-200's shape: engine floor first and non-replaceable, this field only appends. append_fr IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, not merely untranslated - and that absence has a measured consequence, recorded rather than hidden: src/mvf_pack_safety.py's _pick() falls back to ANY other language's value when the requested one is missing, so a French request against this manifest returns the ENGLISH append text with fell_back=True, which the reader records as DISCLAIMER_LANGUAGE_FALLBACK. tests/test_manifest_structural.py asserts that this defect code fires today, on purpose, so the gap is proven rather than assumed. The engine's OWN floor text (ENGINE_DEFAULT_TRIAGE_DISCLAIMER) is unaffected and still delivers correct French - only this pack's addition is missing in French.
triage_disclaimer.append_en: This pack carries published survival and emergency guidance, not a search and rescue team. It tells you what official sources publish for the next few minutes and hours. It will not tell you whether to move if the guidance says stay put, and it does not cover first aid or medical care. If you can reach 911, or a person, reach them.

_practitioner_routing_deliberately_absen: Same reasoning as mvf-pack-vet: this pack routes to 911 and to search and rescue, which is already the engine crisis floor's job, not a clinician route. structural_report() will report NO_PRACTITIONER_ROUTING, exactly as it does for VET, and that costs this pack nothing: the erp holding path (src/chat/app.py erp_holding_reply) never offers a model election and never consults readiness for one.
_crisis_resources_deliberately_absent: Same reasoning as mvf-pack-vet, one level over: there is no single verified NATIONAL number for search-and-rescue or roadside emergency the way 988 is national for crisis support - SAR dispatch is provincial/RCMP/911, not a hotline with its own number. 911 and 988 are already the engine floor. Adding an unverified number here would be exactly the R-115 class this project has already paid for once. If a verified national number is ever found, it is added the same way VET's is designed to be: cleared against the same source whitelist as every other claim in this pack.
_pack_id_and_generation: Included even though this pack issues no grants today (it has no content.questions_csv, no report_blocks, nothing generate_handler.py resolves at import), because plan/PIVOT/PACKS_SPEC.md section 2 already names ERP as a future BUNDLED-not-optional download using this exact field as its update counter. Set now so a later download pipeline does not need a second authoring pass just to add a version number.

content._note: Not generate_handler.py's content.* shape (questions_csv/tod_criteria_dir/conditions/prompt) - this pack drafts no report and that whole block is correctly absent, exactly as it is absent from mvf-pack-vet's manifest. These are ERP's own content files, read directly by anything that renders this pack, not by generate_handler.
